title: Bone Metastases Database of Patients Treated Surgically for Impending or Pathologic Fracture of Long Bones
summary: The aims of this study are to collect prospective data on the natural history of bone metastases (BMs) and skeleta related events (SREs),
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with long bone metastases treated surgically with intramedullary nail or endoprosthetic reconstruction

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with bone metastases of the spine
